founding.label: Chapter I: The Founding
founding.tint: ivory-white and pale holy gold: a soft white-gold sheen on the metal and a faint warm white-gold glow on its edges

winter.label: Chapter II: The Long Winter
winter.tint: pale frost blue: rime and hoarfrost on it, cool pale-blue highlights and a faint icy-blue glow on its edges

burning.label: Chapter III: The Burning
burning.tint: ember red: soot, scorch marks, glowing ember-red highlights and a faint red-orange glow on its edges

watch.label: Chapter IV: The Night Watch
watch.tint: deep violet and shadow: moonlit violet highlights, dark tones and a faint violet glow on its edges

hunt.label: Chapter V: The Hunt
hunt.tint: forest green: earthy browns with green accents and a faint green glow on its edges

treasury.label: Chapter VI: The Treasury
treasury.tint: deep rich coin-gold and amber: heavy warm gold with amber highlights and a faint amber glow on its edges

askel.label: Askel, the Cinderhound
askel.tint: Askel the Cinderhound's colours: charcoal black with glowing molten orange-red cracks and embers

nivra.label: Nivra, the Rime Wyrm
nivra.tint: Nivra the Rime Wyrm's colours: glacial ice blue, translucent white crystal and pale frost mist

aurelan.label: Aurelan, the Lion of Dawn
aurelan.tint: Aurelan the Lion of Dawn's colours: radiant sunrise gold with warm rose-gold and coral highlights

voltara.label: Voltara, the Copper Goddess
voltara.tint: Voltara the Copper Goddess's colours: polished copper and bronze clockwork with crackling electric-blue lightning

gorm.label: Gorm, the Quarry Titan
gorm.tint: Gorm the Quarry Titan's colours: pale weathered granite, green moss and glowing molten-orange seams

vaelkhar.label: Vaelkhar, the Dragon King
vaelkhar.tint: Vaelkhar the Dragon King's colours: glossy obsidian black with deep violet sheen and touches of gold

storied.label: Storied
storied.tint: rich gold, the finest of all, with a faint warm golden glow around the object
